verdict.rationale: Mintlify auto-generates llms.txt/llms-full.txt, markdown exports, and skill.md files for agent consumption, and this is independently confirmed by a live probe returning a working llms.txt at mintlify.com. This directly enables an AI agent to be pointed at agent-oriented docs formats. Missing for 10: independent third-party verification that llms-full.txt/skill.md render correctly across customer sites (only vendor's own site probed).
